description: Analyze a SYNTHETIC biomarker panel with Phi Longevity's PRISM engine. Returns tiered, guideline-cited recommendations. For research/education with SYNTHETIC or de-identified data only. Do NOT submit protected health information (PHI). This endpoint is stateless and does not store inputs.

biomarkers.description: Map of biomarker name -> numeric value, e.g. { "Hemoglobin A1c": 5.4 }. SYNTHETIC ONLY.

name: analyze_biomarkers

expires_at_ms.description: Epoch ms when the unclaimed panel is hard-deleted.
